subject: Temporary invoice cadence bridge for Solace AI - exec review
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@solaceai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice cadence request for onboarding period

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from Accounting here — Solace AI is finalizing PO and vendor onboarding but their treasury team has asked if we can invoice on a quarterly schedule for the first three invoices (covering Q2 and Q3 usage) rather than the standard monthly/net30 cadence. They prefer consolidated statements and only run vendor payments per quarter.

We understand this is non-standard. Proposed compromise from our side: Solace can provide an initial 30% deposit for the first invoice and issue a PO that covers the quarterly cycle; subsequent quarterly invoices would be payable Net60. They are comfortable with a two-quarter pilot (Q2–Q3) and would revert to monthly thereafter.

Can you let us know what information you need for an approval? We can share the PO and the SOW (attached). Looking to close procurement this week so implementation isn't delayed.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Patel
Director, Partnerships | Solace AI
[jordan.patel@solaceai.com]

Attachments: Solace_SOW_Q2-2027.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@solaceai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence request for onboarding period

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and for the SOW. Looping in Sean (rev ops) and Laura (legal).

Quick read on options so we can expedite:
- Option A (preferred): Temporary quarterly invoicing for first two quarters with a 30% upfront deposit for Q2 invoice + Net60 for the remaining quarterly invoices. Requires a short amendment to the SOW and Finance sign-off.
- Option B: Standard monthly/net30 but accept a single consolidated invoice per month (no billing cadence change).
- Option C: Quarterly billing with a 2% fee to cover working capital — we generally avoid fees but could consider for large customers.

Please confirm whether Solace can provide the initial deposit and a signed PO by EOD Wednesday. If yes, we will prepare an amendment and route for expedited approval. Attaching a proposed amendment draft for reference.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_invoice_cadence_amendment.docx (docx)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Invoice cadence request for onboarding period — exec approval needed

Kimberly / Laura —

I reviewed Solace's payment profile and deal economics (Deal DL-2027-058). Recommendation to accept a temporary quarterly cadence for two quarters with these controls:
1) 30% upfront deposit on the first quarterly invoice (to reduce cash exposure).
2) Finance to run a basic credit/ACH validation and place an initial credit hold until deposit clears.
3) Amendment limited to two quarters; automatic reversion to standard terms at renewal unless explicitly reapproved.
4) Legal to add a clause disallowing SLA/feature changes tied to the billing term (no scope dilution).

Rationale: preserves revenue recognition predictability while enabling a strategic customer to onboard quickly. Operational ask: Marissa — would you approve as a one-time exception for Solace? If yes, Laura can prepare the signature-ready amendment and I will coordinate with Finance to book the deposit invoice.

-Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Mar 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Invoice cadence request for onboarding period — exec approval needed

Approved with conditions.

Marissa (executive) grants a one-time exception to allow Solace AI a temporary quarterly invoicing cadence for the first two quarters (Q2 and Q3 2027) under the following binding conditions:
- 30% upfront deposit due before access is provisioned; deposit to be applied to the first quarterly invoice.
- Finance to complete ACH/credit validation; if validation fails, default to standard net30 and require payment by credit card.
- Amendment to the SOW executed via DocuSign prior to first invoice; amendment will expire automatically at the end of Q3 2027 unless explicitly extended.
- No changes to SLAs or pricing other than billing cadence; no additional discounts granted.

Laura — please prepare the amendment (use Deal DL-2027-058). Sean — coordinate invoicing schedule and confirm receipt of deposit. Kimberly — please inform Solace and request the signed PO + deposit by close of business next Tuesday.

Good work getting to a pragmatic solution.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Forwarded-attachment references: proposed_invoice_cadence_amendment.docx, Solace_SOW_Q2-2027.pdf
